name: LLM (Master of Laws) — University of London

selected_options.selection_rationale: Commercial/IP-adjacent spread, chosen for continuity with the LLB's real University of London sourcing and to keep the LLM commercially and internationally focused ahead of SQE1/SQE2.

material_vintage: University of London LLM (International Programmes), live 2026-27 programme page and module list at london.ac.uk/study/courses/postgraduate/llm-postgraduate-laws, itemised 2026-09-22. Each of the four chosen modules is confirmed by UoL's own module short-course page to be examined via four separately-assessed sub-modules (A-D), and this course itemises at that real sub-module level. UoL's detailed module study guides, module-specific examiners' reports and the numeric marking-band descriptors referenced in the Programme Regulations as 'Appendix D - Assessment criteria' are gated behind the VLE (student login) and were not accessible; where a stage's rubric states a percentage band or pass mark it is transcribed from the openly-accessible 2026-27 Programme Regulations PDF, not invented. Doctrinal content within each sub-module is itemised from the standard postgraduate commercial-law topic breakdown for that subject (as found in leading practitioner and academic texts for Advanced Contract Law, IP, International Trade Law and EU Competition Law), taught at Master's depth: more theoretical, comparative and critical than the LLB, less procedural hand-holding, with named critical-angle evaluation questions built into every sub-module.
level_source: RQF/FHEQ Level 7 (Master's degree), per QAA Framework for Higher Education Qualifications
